name: One Click Login as User – Instant User Switching for Admins
author: royalnavneet

sections.description:
Login as a User is the ultimate admin tool for WordPress, WooCommerce, SureCart, and MemberPress. Instantly log in as any user or customer with a single click—no password needed! Perfect for support, troubleshooting, and managing user accounts.

Key Features:
– One-click “Login as” button in the user list and user profile (FREE)
– Secure session switching with return-to-admin button
– Translation-ready (English, German, and more)
– Compatible with WordPress 6.x, WooCommerce, SureCart, MemberPress
– Floating “Return to Admin” button on frontend and backend
– Fully secure: permission checks, nonce protection, no login-as-self

Pro Features:
– Login as Customer from WooCommerce orders, subscriptions, SureCart, MemberPress
– Role-based permissions for user switching
– Shortcode for frontend login-as button
– Priority support and updates

Credits

Developed by Lytechx Digital
https://lytechx.com

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/login-as-user directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the “Login as” button in the Users list or user profile.
  4. For Pro features, upgrade via the plugin settings or [your upgrade link].
sections.faq:
Is it secure?

Yes! Only administrators (or allowed roles in Pro) can use the feature. All actions are protected by WordPress nonces and permissions.

Can I return to my admin account?

Yes, a floating “Return to Admin” button appears on every page when impersonating another user.

Does it work with WooCommerce, SureCart, MemberPress?

Yes! Pro version adds deep integration with these plugins.

Is it translation-ready?

Yes, with .pot, .po, and .mo files included.
